review: Book 1 people versus current approved sources
scope: All 16 current restarted spreads, actual pages 02-33; includes four initial approvals and twelve candidates. Historical superseded drafts are not the active book sequence.

mechanical_verification.final_original_spread_hashes: All 16 raw spread SHA-256 values rechecked unchanged after report generation.

source_exception_interpretation: Ben.png, Leo.png and Ben profile were modified on 2026-10-25; current master images explicitly incorporate approved newer turnarounds. Current bytes were inspected, their actual hashes recorded here, and the old registry hashes were not silently changed. All 24 separate approved eight-view/R8 PNG hashes match the current approval manifest.
limitations: Visual comparison was a manual inspection of original images and enlarged crops; no script certified likeness.
No blanket PASS: concealed views, back-of-vest emblems, exact physical height, and unreadable microdetail remain UNVERIFIED.
No clear hair-through-helmet bleed was identified in the inspected visible regions. This does not certify hidden regions.
The operator in the excavator cab on pages 24-25 cannot be identified at the supplied resolution; source identity is UNVERIFIED.
This is a completed review with a correction register, not a corrected-artwork release or a new approval.
